result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there are a few visual issues: duplicated restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, truncated restaurant name text, and a partially cut-off category chip on the right edge.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image, delivery time (15–25 min), and price (€0.90 delivery) side by side, which looks like duplicated/placeholder data rather than distinct restaurants.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel pulls distinct restaurants; if only one matching restaurant exists, avoid rendering duplicate cards or show different menu items/dishes.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' ('Smash Bros Bu...') has its restaurant name truncated at the right screen edge without a clear affordance that more content is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll indicator or edge fade gradient to signal horizontal scrollability, and ensure truncation uses an ellipsis consistently.

issues.description: The category filter chip row is cut off at the right edge (a partially visible chip after 'Healthy'), which may not be obvious to users that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade or scroll hint to indicate additional filter chips are available via horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The two 'Green Bowl Poké' card images sit on a plain light-gray background while the 'Smash Bros' card uses a rich dark photo background, creating inconsistent visual weight across cards in the same row.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent image treatment (same background style, sizing, and framing) across all cards in the carousel for visual cohesion.
